name: Tokyo

flag.description: A white six-rayed sun with a hollow center on a deep purple field.
flag.symbolism: The emblem, made for Tokyo City in 1889, weaves the characters 日本東京 ("Japan, Tokyo") into a sun shining in six directions; the purple is Edo murasaki, the color of old Edo.

hook: Tokyo flies a white six-rayed sun on Edo purple; Gunma's white emblem on purple is three crescents.
trivia: The metropolitan government sits in Shinjuku; Tokyo has had no single capital city since Tokyo City merged into the metropolis in 1943.
The flag was adopted on 1 October 1964, days before the Tokyo Olympics opened.
